# NIST Wi-Fi CSI Respiratory Motion Dataset

**Aliases:** BreatheSmart CSI Data

Raw Wi-Fi CSI measurements collected with an anatomically correct breathing manikin for respiratory-motion monitoring and algorithm evaluation.

## Supported wireless tasks

### [Vital Sign Sensing](../tasks/vital-sign-sensing.md)

**Inputs:** Wi-Fi CSI

**Targets:** Respiratory motion

**Scope:** Estimate or classify respiratory motion patterns from time-varying Wi-Fi CSI.

**Task context:** Environment: Laboratory · Mobility: Not applicable

The released measurements come from a breathing manikin, not human study participants.

## Caveats

- The respiratory-motion data were collected from an anatomically correct breathing manikin; they should not be described as a human-subject physiological dataset.
